name: memgit
tagline: Versioned memory shared by Cline, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex on every machine
description: memgit gives every MCP host one memory store. It imports Claude Code's own memory files, keeps every change as a checkpoint with diff and rollback, ranks recall with BM25, and syncs end-to-end encrypted between machines when sync is turned on. Local stdio server; needs Python 3.11+.
